event: MiCA transitional period ends, EU-wide CASP grandfathering window closes (ESMA confirmed no extension)
note: Last day of the 18-month grandfathering period. From this date any crypto-asset service provider operating on legacy national registration without a MiCA authorisation loses transitional cover anywhere in the EU. Several states (Germany, Ireland, Netherlands, Poland) closed theirs earlier.

event: zkSync Era mainnet upgrade (ZK Stack v2 with boojum)
CLARITY Act, last pre-recess floor window before the Senate leaves for August recess
note: The Senate sits the first week of August. Majority Leader John Thune said on July 23 he would like to at least get Clarity started and would see where the votes are. No cloture motion has been filed and the bill still has to be reconciled with Senate Agriculture's S. 3755.

event: Glamsterdam upgrade live on mainnet (EIP-7732, EIP-7691)
Staking Solana ETF decisions pending (spot SOL ETFs live since Oct 28 2025; VanEck JitoSOL and other staking variants awaiting SEC sign-off)
note: Spot Solana ETFs already trade with staking built in (Bitwise BSOL, Grayscale, Fidelity, 21Shares and others). The open catalyst is approval of staking-focused variants such as VanEck JitoSOL, noticed by the SEC in March 2026. Date is estimated under the new ~75-day generic listing standard.

event: Firedancer validator client mainnet launch (Jump Crypto)
POL token migration complete (MATIC to POL full transition)
Senate returns from August recess, final practical floor window for the CLARITY Act in 2026
note: Senators are then scheduled out of Washington for nearly all of October ahead of the November 3 midterms. September floor time competes with appropriations and nominations, and a market structure bill carries no funding cliff to force action.

event: Binance Launchpad IEO (project TBD, typically quarterly)
ARB token unlock (1.12B tokens, ~$1.2B at current prices)
dYdX v4 mainnet launch (Cosmos-based perpetuals DEX)
Fee switch activation vote (UNI stakers earn protocol fees)
SEC ruling on spot XRP ETF (final deadline)
Coinbase listing for major token (likely L2 or DeFi protocol)
Midterm elections, CLARITY Act dies with the 119th Congress if not enacted
note: Any bill not enacted by the end of this Congress must be reintroduced from scratch, into a Senate with different composition and committee leadership. Senator Lummis called the coming weeks likely the last real chance for years.
